params.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

BBL NICE — GOOD COMPANY.
Preserve the exact illustrated adult woman: long voluminous blonde ponytail and pink scrunchie, gold hoop earrings and bracelets, white top, cropped pink track jacket, pink cargo track pants with white stripes and white/pink chunky sneakers. Her personality is friendly, confident and glamorous.
0–0.7s: full-body stance; she opens both hands in a welcoming gesture and gently blows two tiny golden-pink hearts from one palm.
0.7–2.4s: the hearts race apart through the cyan depth, then expand into TWO ENORMOUS winged heart guardians made of layered pink ribbons and gold feathers. Camera rockets back as they orbit her from opposite sides; their energy passes between them as a bright gold infinity loop. They meet behind her in a colossal synchronized pink-gold starburst, wings flaring and a brief impact hold. This is shared empowerment and companionship, not an attack. Clear cyan through and around all finite ribbons; no solid backdrop.
2.4–3.5s: camera SNAP-PUSHES toward her smiling face as exact title "GOOD COMPANY" slams in two bold comic lines beside her, matching the giant shared pulse.
3.5–5s: the guardians fold into two tiny glowing hearts; she catches one on each palm, brings them together with a playful wink and holds the welcoming hero pose. Ponytail settles, title remains legible. Sound: two bright spark chimes, rising twin wing rushes, huge synchronized pulse, title slam, paired final chimes. No dialogue or music, no camera emphasis on isolated body parts. Five seconds total.

BBOY — WINDMILL.
Preserve the exact illustrated male breakdancer: red knit beanie, dark curly hair and small goatee, gold hoop/chain, teal track jacket with white stripes over white shirt, loose khaki trousers, red/white sneakers and wristbands. Keep the approved teal jacket color; generated energy is warm gold/red, NOT teal. Clearly preserve two arms and two legs during motion.
0–0.7s: establish full body in a cocky crouch; he plants one palm and kicks both legs wide into the opening of a windmill.
0.7–2.4s: he performs a blistering continuous windmill rotation, shoulders and hands alternating support in believable breakdance mechanics while legs sweep broad arcs. 3.5–5s: ease wide enough to show the complete balanced freeze; he gives a confident little nod while one loose shoelace continues swinging and the final wind ring settles. Hold title and iconic silhouette. Sound: rhythmic clothing swishes, rapidly accelerating spin whoosh, enormous final wind crack, title slam, sneaker squeak. No backing music or speech. Five seconds total.

BIG CITY PIGEON — RUN YOUR BREADCRUMBS.

0.7–2.4s: camera chases the pigeon as it corkscrews through a colossal spiral of bread crumbs and golden air streaks. The loaf cuts an enormous crescent through the crumb cloud, ending in a huge gold-white comic impact burst. 2.4–3.5s: SNAP-PUSH onto the pigeon's fierce orange eyes with the giant loaf over its shoulder as exact title "RUN YOUR BREADCRUMBS" slams in three clear comic lines.
3.5–5s: camera pulls out to reveal it proudly standing on the oversized baguette; after all that spectacle it delicately pecks the original tiny crumb and gives an indignant head bob. Hold clear bird silhouette and title. Sound: explosive wing flap, accelerating gust whistle, enormous loaf swing, title slam, tiny comic peck and short pigeon coo without words. Five seconds total.

BLACK COWBOY — WANTED.
Preserve the exact illustrated Black male cowboy: tan wide-brimmed hat with feather, cream open-collar shirt, blue denim vest and jeans, leather belt and holster, brown boots. Preserve his brown horse with dark mane, white forehead marking, bridle, saddle and reins; he remains mounted. One lasso. Keep holstered equipment holstered.
0–1.2s: establish the complete horse and rider. Horse paws once while he calmly rotates a small lasso loop, face shaded by the hat.

Horse stops in a balanced dramatic rear as the rope cinches the comet into an immense five-point star badge behind horse and rider, thunderous gold/ivory burst and brief impact hold. Maintain believable horse anatomy and secure rider; no injury.
4.8–6s: camera SNAP-PUSHES to his composed face as exact title "WANTED" stamps diagonally into the clear upper frame, thick comic outlines and explosive stamp accent.
